reviews.review_title: 👹 I'm Monster – Unleash Your Inner Kaij
reviews.review_description:
I'm Monster is a fantastic mix of arcade action, sandbox gameplay, and pure nostalgic fun! The lobby takes you straight back to the '90s, with simplified versions of classic hits like OutRun and Street Fighter II. Collecting tokens to upgrade your character adds a nice sense of progression and makes the whole experience even more enjoyable.

Once you've had your fill of nostalgia, it's time to unleash your inner monster! Playing as a giant creature reminiscent of King Kong, you take on a variety of missions, from tearing down a pizza shop sign to causing chaos throughout the environment. Finding creative ways to complete your objectives is part of the fun, and earning experience over time gives you a rewarding sense of progression.

The sandbox concept is great, and the execution is solid. The missions offer variety, encouraging you to explore, experiment, and discover different ways to wreak havoc. And let's be honest, there's something incredibly satisfying about being the bad guy for once and bouncing humans around like toys!

A fun, well-executed VR experience that combines retro gaming nostalgia with monster-sized destruction. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a playful sandbox with plenty of arcade charm!

developer_response.body: Thank you so much for the thoughtful review! 👹 We're glad you enjoyed the retro atmosphere and getting creative with the destruction. More improvements are on the way, and your support means a lot to our small indie studio. Have fun causing chaos!
